page.layout: One page of text: running head at top centre; verse poem at top, then a rule, then a heading and a dedicatory poem in two-line blocks with a large initial; page signature at the bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Non ego, non eheu, morientia lumina Vidi,
Altera pro Christo dum me pia cura remordet
Effe pium fic me, Pietas (mirabile dictu)
At tibi, chare parens, quæ præsens soluere iusta
En tandem, extincto mæstus persoluit, & ipsis
main_text.head: CLARISS. MATRONÆ, MARIÆ Burdelottæ, tum genere, tum virtute nobilis, matris dulciss. Memoriæ.
main_text.p:
VIxdum Viuere cœperam puellus,
Mater, Viuere quando desisti,
main_text.l: Vt te Vix ego dixerim parentem,
Vix tu me quoque filium Vocaris:
Hinc lustris tibi quinque iam sepulchri

page.notes: The top verse block is set in italic; the first-line initial V of the dedicatory poem is a large woodcut-style initial. The signature at the foot is partly cut off and uncertain. Some words are doubtful due to the scan's quality; the long-s forms have been normalised to s.
